items.stem: In class 6 of a school, 105 students study in different sections. The number of students in each section are between 20 and 40. All sections have equal number of students.How equal number of students can be accommodated in each section?
items.answer: 3 sections with 35 students in each section | 5 sections with 21 students in each section Finds prime factors of 105 which results in the required range

items.stem: A photographer is hired to take group photographs of students in each class in a school. He arranges the students along with teachers in rows for the photograph. His arrangement has: at most 50 people; an equal number of people in each row A row consists of a minimum of 3 people and a maximum of 8 people. There are 35 people (students and teachers) in a class for a group photograph. What are the possible arrangements for them?
items.answer: 7 rows and 5 students/teacher per row 7 students/teacher per row and 5 rows

items.stem: A photographer is hired to take group photographs of students in each class in a school. He arranges the students along with teachers in rows for the photograph. His arrangement has: at most 50 people; an equal number of people in each row A row consists of a minimum of 3 people and a maximum of 8 people. The photographer arranged some of the students in 6 rows. What can be the maximum number of students in the photograph?

A photographer is hired to take group photographs of students in each class in a school. He arranges the students along with teachers in rows for the photograph. His arrangement has: at most 50 people; an equal number of people in each row A row consists of a minimum of 3 people and a maximum of 8 people. The students of Class 7 which are 30 in number want to take a photograph along with 2 teachers.Which of the following is the possible arrangement for them?

options.label: C
options.text: 5 rows with 6 students in each and 1 row for teachers

options.label: D
options.text: 6 rows with 4 students in each and 1 row for teachers

items.answer: B. 4 rows with 8 students/teachers in each

Medium 80 Large 100 150 photographs worth Rs. 10,250 were sold. If 75 of them were of small size, find how many large size photographs were sold?

Write co-prime pairs using the three consecutive numbers 13, 14 and 15.

For an international school competition, students’ stay is booked in two hotels – 148 students in Hotel 1 and 164 students in Hotel 2. An equal number of students are accommodated in each hotel room. What can be the maximum number of students in a room?

John, Rishi and Feroz participated in track events. During practice sessions, their coach observed that John took 48 seconds, Rishi took 72 seconds and Feroz took 108 seconds to run around a circular track. If they start running together at 6 am for half an hour, how many times will they all come together at a same position?

Jaya baked muffins using paper liners and cherries. Some paper liner packets contain 8 liners, while others contain 10 liners. A packet of cherry contains 6 cherries. Every muffin Jaya baked contained 1 cherry. All cherries and paper liners were used up. What can be the minimum number of muffins baked by her?
Jaya baked and sold vanilla muffins at Rs. 15 and chocolate muffin at Rs. 18. She earned equal amounts from the sale of both muffins. How many vanilla and chocolate muffins did she sell?
items.answer: Accept multiples of 6 for vanilla muffins and multiples of 5 for chocolate muffins. | 6 vanilla and 5 chocolate | 12 vanilla and 10 chocolate | 24 vanilla and 20 chocolate
